_about: Example authority settings for agents working Linear issues. Copy this to instance/authority.json (or point AUTHORITY_FILE at your own file) and edit it. Read by scripts/lib/authority.mjs. Anything the file does not clearly allow is refused.

early-dev._about: No production risk. Agents carry work to a deployed result.

early-dev-no-checks._about: Same as early-dev, for repos with no automated checks. The merge waits on the verifier only.

live._about: Agents stop at a pull request. The owner merges.

client._about: Client work. Never routed to these agents.

repos._about: One line per repo folder under the code folder: "name": "tier". A repo not listed here gets default_tier.

deploy_on_merge._about: What a merge to main ships, per repo, so the runner can say so in its comment. It describes only: nothing here makes the runner deploy. ships is null when no deploy path is known.

example-sandbox.gap: This example repo has no deploy path.

backends._about: Which agent builds an issue. claude is the default and needs no entry. A backend runs only when enabled is true.
